nodes.label: EDIT: the spreads and their positions

metadata.comment: A position is { name, lead, index, x, y, turn }. x and y place it on the table, in card widths (a card is 1 wide and 1.7 tall), measured to its middle; turn: 90 lays it sideways (the Celtic Cross's crossing card). Add a spread by adding an entry; the home page lists them all.
